one_liner: Turns an invoice into a real on-chain payment — with a human review step, explicit confirmation, and a paid-stamp ledger that makes double-payment impossible.
what_it_does: This lamp reads an invoice, shows it to a human for review, and only pays after explicit confirmation. Once an invoice is paid, it gets a permanent paid stamp — a second attempt to pay the same invoice is refused, not paid again. Proven by 1 real payment plus 1 refused duplicate on the Atlantic testnet, all linked below.
